description: Order book snapshot and update message format

updates.event_time: string - ISO8601 timestamp of price level change
updates.new_quantity: string - updated quantity at this level (0 = remove level)

field_descriptions.side: bid = buy side of book, ask = sell side
field_descriptions.price_level: Price at which this liquidity is available
field_descriptions.new_quantity: Total quantity at this price. 0 = price level removed from book
field_descriptions.event_time: When this price level changed (for ordering updates)

important_notes: new_quantity is total quantity at level, NOT a delta
new_quantity of '0' means remove that price level from your local order book
First message is always 'snapshot' (full book), subsequent are 'update' messages
Updates are atomic per price level - apply them in order
processing_strategy: 1. Receive snapshot message - initialize order book with all bids and asks
2. Receive update messages - apply each update (add/update/remove price level)
3. Maintain separate data structures for bids (descending price) and asks (ascending price)
4. Track sequence_num to detect missed messages

python_structure.bids: dict[price_level: str, quantity: str] - sorted descending
python_structure.asks: dict[price_level: str, quantity: str] - sorted ascending

implementation_example.update_logic: if new_quantity == '0': delete price_level else: bids[price_level] = new_quantity

integration: Use to calculate midpoint price, track depth, detect large orders, analyze liquidity
